requests.prompt: Create one original landscape game UI background, approximately 1536 by 864, 16:9. A beautiful yet restrained OPEN PHYSICAL BIBLE seen directly from overhead, perfectly symmetrical two-page spread, thin dark oxblood-brown leather cover subtly visible beneath fine cream paper. Warm realistic painterly light, minute paper fibers, worn page edges and sewn center binding, one slim red ribbon extending slightly below the lower center. The open book fills the frame with about 3% outer margin against a very dark desaturated teal tabletop. This should feel like an actual cherished Bible, not an ornate fantasy spell book. NO letters, glyphs, writing, numerals, printed text, chapter ornaments, pictures, jewels, clasps, wings or heavy golden borders anywhere. Both pages must be almost flat with a gentle natural center curve, evenly lit ivory writing surfaces, no heavy shadows under the future text. Important layout for later engine-rendered text: large clear empty rectangular left writing region is x=9.5% to 46% of image width and y=10% to 80.5% of image height; right writing region is x=52.6% to 89.5%, y=10% to 80.5%. Keep those regions uniformly pale and completely empty. Subtle fine gold page edging only at the very outside, subdued leather and fine bookbinding realism. High-quality quiet sacred reading interface, convincing materials, readable large surfaces, no text overlay. Flat 2D illustration for a Bible UI, not a photograph of a perspective scene. This is original art, not copied from any game.

Create one ORIGINAL biblical story illustration atlas, square approximately 1536x1536, divided into an EXACT 2 by 2 grid of four equally sized square illustrations, edge-to-edge with NO gutters, dividing lines, lettering, text, symbols, captions, UI or watermarks. This is a quiet high quality painterly story-game illustration atlas with warm olive green, sapphire blue and amber light, believable modest 1st-century Judean and Galilean stone homes and cloth garments, natural Levantine adult people, soft detailed faces, natural anatomy. Original interpretive artwork, no copied game imagery. Each quadrant should read as a cinematic wide composition: place all important people and narrative actions within the central 56% of that quadrant's height, so it can later crop to 16:9 without losing the event; nonessential sky/walls/floor at top and bottom. Keep each quadrant entirely separate and correctly located:
TOP LEFT: The annunciation to Mary in a simple Nazareth stone house. A young adult Mary in modest cream and muted blue linen with a light head veil sits at a low work table, startled yet thoughtful, looking toward a gentle luminous open doorway suggesting the angelic message. NO infant or child anywhere, no halos, no elaborate throne, no fantasy magic effects or glitter.
TOP RIGHT: Mary warmly greets the elderly Elizabeth in an intimate Judean hill-country courtyard beside a simple doorway and an olive tree. Both women in modest linen robes and veils, hands meeting, expressions of trust and joy. NO babies or children anywhere. Natural family encounter, not a royal palace.
BOTTOM LEFT: Joseph's dream, a bearded adult carpenter sleeping on a simple straw bed beside a small workbench and ordinary wood tools in a humble stone room. Quiet warm light falls through the doorway, suggesting the dream. No visible child or infant. No fantasy workshop, no intricate machinery. Focus on Joseph and peaceful light.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Magi visiting a YOUNG CHILD with Mary inside a modest Bethlehem HOUSE, clearly a domestic interior with stone walls and a simple doorway, NOT a stable or manger. Show TWO visible visiting eastern travelers in dignified but restrained travel robes, with additional company only suggested outside, not a fixed count of three. They kneel or respectfully bow and offer small gifts. Mary holds or sits beside the young child. NO shepherds, animals, hay, manger, Christmas tree, European crowns or halos. This is a distinct later visit, not the same-night shepherd scene.
Avoid decorative jewels, game skills, glowing weapons, photoreal modern clothing and church interiors. All four must be equally rich detailed matching art style and equally legible, gentle atmospheric depth, human moments rather than spectacle.
